coach.body: 80 days, 26 resumes, 26 compactions: every morning re-bought the whole pile, and every compaction silently decided what your project's history was. Move memory to files (notes.md + CLAUDE.md); make fresh sessions cheap.
coach.recipe: End each task with a notes.md handoff, start the next fresh
